name: Eralee Barnes
source:
Gii's classmate from ten years ago. 
They'd once studied medicine together in Inganock's Upper Tier University, after the Revival he opened a hospital and met with reasonable success, working on humans who had barely any mutations.
His operating hours were from 1 to 7 PM on weekdays, closed on weekends.
It was said that he held parties every weekend.
(Edited from in-game text)
